title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy 1982 gem with smoking Spanish Jam, Scarlet>Fire and other classics, captured on a decent but slightly muddy audience tape.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the show’s nonstop excitement – standout moments include an epic Spanish Jam, a flawless second set flowing from Scarlet > Fire into Terrapin Station, and powerful renditions of Throwing Stones, The Other One and Sugar Magnolia. The recording is listenable and captures the live vibe, though several reviewers note a muddy overall sound that keeps it from being pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for musical performance (energy, standout songs) across many reviews; recording quality is good but noted as muddy, lowering the technical score slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally listenable with strong crowd presence, but several listeners describe the mix as muddy and lacking clarity in places.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set praised for seamless transitions (e.g., Scarlet > Fire into Terrapin) and a near‑flawless flow; first set also remembered fondly.

band_member_comments.Phil: Playing a four‑string bass and even opening the riff to The Other One, noted as a positive difference.
